_note: Band missions from the live client's Mayhem hub (kiwi-hub.json, Kiwi_S3). metric names the per-game estimate headliners.py ranks champions by; tip is for missions any champion can do. Worlds is left out until 26.22 is live.

missions.title: Dance in the middle of the map
missions.description: Type /dance, /d, or use your Dance hotkey (set in settings)
missions.tip: Walk to the middle of the bridge and type /dance. Any champion works.

missions.title: Score 45 champion takedowns in a game
missions.description: Takedowns include both kills and assists

missions.title: Land Skillshots 45 times in a game
missions.description: Skillshots are aiming abilities (line, cone, or area)
steps: Land Skillshots 65 times in a game

missions.title: Hit enemy champions with Snowballs 8 times in a game
missions.description: Hit enemy champions with the Summoner Spell, Snowball (Mark)
steps: Hit enemy champions with Snowballs 12 times in a game
missions.tip: Throw Snowball every time it's up, at close or slowed targets. Any champion works.

missions.title: Snipe enemy champions 50 times in a game
missions.description: Use spells to hit enemy champions from 600+ range

missions.title: Score 15 champion takedowns, each within 3 seconds of dashing
missions.description: Multiple Takedowns after one dash will be scored additively

missions.title: Heal or Omnivamp 3,000 of your own health in a game
missions.description: Self-heal or Omnivamp via items, augments, anvils, and spells
steps: Heal or Omnivamp 6,000 of your own health in a game

missions.title: Deal a total of 5,000 damage to champions with Augments
missions.description: Deal bonus damage with augments like "Get Jinxed" in one game
steps: Deal a total of 7,000 damage to champions with Augments
missions.tip: Pick damage augments such as Get Jinxed. Any champion works, and damage-heavy ones finish it faster.

missions.title: Reroll augments 6 times
missions.description: This needs to be done in one game
missions.tip: Use every reroll you get in your augment picks. Any champion works.

missions.title: Gain 5,000 bonus Health in a game
missions.description: Gain bonus Health via items, augments, spells, and anvils

missions.title: Immobilize or Slow enemy champions 75 times in a game
missions.description: Immobilize (Stun, Root, etc.) counts for double
steps: Immobilize or Slow enemy champions 100 times in a game

missions.title: Achieve a total of 300 bonus AD or AP in a game
missions.description: Gain bonus AD/AP via items, augments, anvils, and spells
steps: Achieve a total of 400 bonus AD or AP in a game

missions.title: Emote while dashing with Snowball
missions.description: Steps: Snowball (Mark) > Emote (using Emote wheel) > Recast Snowball (Dash)
missions.tip: Hit a Snowball, open the emote wheel, then recast Snowball while the emote plays. Any champion works.

missions.title: Achieve 200% bonus Attack Speed
missions.description: Gain bonus AS via leveling up, items, augments, anvils, and spells

missions.title: Deal a total of 4,000 damage to champions with Ultimate
missions.description: This needs to be done in one game
steps: Deal a total of 6,000 damage to champions with Ultimate

missions.title: Hit multiple champions with an ability 25 times in a game
missions.description: Any abilities in your champion kit count
steps: Hit multiple champions with an ability 45 times in a game
